title: WatershedDelineation
description: Per-asset upstream drainage area summary. Geometry stays in a separate sidecar file under outputs/geometry/ so the entity record can fit in the Base44 envelope and the JSON Schema gate stays fast. Set `geometry_sidecar` to the relative path of the GeoJSON.

nhdplus_id.description: NHDPlusID at the snap point that the watershed was delineated from.

headwater_comids.description: COMIDs at the upstream edges of the delineated area; empty when the snap point is itself a headwater.

geometry_sidecar.description: Relative path to the GeoJSON sidecar (e.g. 'geometry/watershed_<asset_id>.geojson'); null when the geometry wasn't persisted.
